title: 툼 레이더
prompt:
INPUT: text only — no reference image is needed; do not reuse earlier conversation images.

GAME: «툼 레이더» (Tomb Raider), 1996. Genre: adventure. Graphics era: early 3D.

NOT ITS CHARACTERS: an original woman who is the game itself — no face or body of its hero, mascot, characters or creatures (she may wear their outfits); no title logo, box art, real brands, HUD overlay or readable text and numbers. Its items, places, colors, gear and interface shapes may appear recognizably.

NEVER DRAW for this game: "라라 크로프트의 얼굴"; "동물(늑대·곰·공룡)과 괴물의 얼굴"; "피 묘사"; "로고·타이틀 글자"; "체력 막대·숫자".

SIGNATURE (recognizable, as the game shows them): "허벅지의 쌍 권총집", "작은 갈색 가죽 배낭", "횃불", "피라미드 모양 황금 유물".

Quoted notes may be Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

SUBJECT: one adult woman who personifies the video game itself. Persona: "지도에도 없는 무덤을 찾아 세계를 누비며, 맨몸으로 절벽을 오르고 함정을 건너는 고고학자 탐험가". Desire: "잃어버린 유물을 찾는 것"; conflict: "탐구와 위험". Its symbols become costume motifs drawn the way the game shows them, worn, not carried, unless her form or pose puts one in hand: "피라미드 모양 황금 유물", "허벅지의 권총집", "횃불".

AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) whatever her expression.

CORE PLAY: "절벽을 오르고 매달리고 뛰어넘으며, 함정을 읽어 무덤 깊은 곳의 유물을 찾는다" — shown in her bearing and small costume details, never as effects, numbers or a HUD.

ERA LOOK: early 3D era — clean angular tailoring, faceted panels like simple polygons, cool metallic edges — in fabric and trim only, never pixel art or a screenshot.

SILHOUETTE: athletic build; long braids; warm bronze hair; garment structure: a loose open jacket over a tank top and short shorts; main material: weathered teal cotton and tan canvas with leather holster straps; palette: explorer teal against tomb sandstone and torch gold.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): heart-shaped face; wide almond eyes; thin arched brows; straight narrow nose; full wide lips; emerald-green eyes; broad European ancestry with individual variation, no stereotyped features.

FORM — TITLE (타이틀): "탐험 출발 — 청록 민소매 상의와 허리에 묶은 얇은 재킷, 갈색 반바지, 작은 가죽 배낭, 손가락 없는 장갑, 길게 땋은 머리". Battle role: scout. Stage of play: the first power-on — her cleanest look, genre colors most vivid.
GEAR in the game's own style: "청록 민소매와 가죽 배낭".

SETTING (this form): "눈보라가 그친 높은 산맥의 좁은 바위 길" — calm start-screen composition — centered, uncluttered, cool clean light, dark negative space.

HOLD BACK: these moments belong to the open images — keep their events out of this setting, even as a distant figure or reflection: "눈 덮인 계곡 끝에서 거대한 돌문이 천천히 열린다"; "어둠 속 신전 바닥이 꺼지며 가시 함정이 드러난다"; "무너지는 피라미드에서 금빛 빛줄기가 하늘로 솟는다". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a polished, glamorous adult game card illustration — a beautiful face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume with glossy trim, clasps and jewelry framing her game's material; luminous rim light, strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "바위 길 끝에서 한 손으로 이마에 그늘을 지으며 먼 계곡을 살피는 자세" — held still and centered, seen at eye level, easy to read as a card.

EXPRESSION (TITLE): one brow raised higher, head tilted, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted — the mood of this stage, on her own face.

OUTPUT: one full-body card image of this form, which also fixes who she is for every later form. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). Build the background from SETTING; it evokes her game's world without being a screenshot or level map.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands do only what STANCE says and hold only what it names.

FINAL CHECK: glossy Korean mobile-game rendering with selective highlights; an original costume — no character, logo, title lettering or interface from the game.
